answer_1.quote: We evaluate the methods on six criteria for long-form generation tasks

answer_2.quote: We record the True percentage (by using fine-tuned ChatGPT judge) for TruthfulQA, Hallucinated NE Error Factual/Non-factual for FactualityPrompt, Toxicity percentage for BOLD and HurtLex for Queer/Nonqueer HONEST

answer_3.quote: Metrics C5 and C6 are computed automatically via the Win/Draw/Lose comparison between Multi-expert Prompting and other baselines by ChatGPT

answer_4.quote: Human evaluation is essential for assessing the subtask performance of models in Multi-expert Prompting... Three excellent undergraduates who are native English speakers are hired to rate the generation
answer_4.guideline: Rating on a scale of 1-3 for Expert Generation Satisfaction and Aggregation Satisfaction
